notes: Checked every one of 226 lesson-local source bindings against current reviewed lesson JSON, including identity, pronunciation, Vietnamese, POS, text, original audio group, and exact PDF/printed page provenance.

Independently inspected original word-list pixels for all 16 same-form groups. Page-specific reasons record the printed POS, pronunciation or semantic distinction; see docs/content-audit/canonical-lexicon-independent.md.

No legitimate repeated-sense merges exist within this edition under the printed POS/sense contract. All source IDs and stable canonical sense IDs are retained; translation strings alone never decide identity.
Counts are source-backed POS/sense cards and Chinese forms, not the books' advertised 200/500 syllabus targets. AI source/identity review is not native-speaker or full human-listening certification.

sameFormDecisions.reason: PDF26/printed11 labels the recommendation use adv. (had better); PDF102/printed87 labels alternative-question or as conj. Both háishi, but distinct printed POS and grammatical function.
PDF45/printed30 prints neutral-tone guo, part., marking past experience; PDF66/printed51 prints guò, v., spend time/celebrate a birthday. Pronunciation, POS and meaning differ.
PDF53/printed38 explicitly prints adv./adj.: hurry up versus fast. Keep the urging adverb and speed adjective separate.
PDF57/printed42 explicitly prints prep./conj.: with versus and. The prepositional companion and conjunction uses are distinct.
PDF62/printed47 explicitly prints v./n.: draw versus painting. Action and resulting picture have different POS.
PDF72/printed57 explicitly prints prep./v.: towards versus go. Directional preposition and motion verb are distinct.

PDF72/printed57 prints dǎ, v., with two meanings: play (games) and hit. Preserve l07-word05 for playing a hand-based sport/game and l07-word06 for striking; identical spelling, pronunciation and POS do not erase this semantic distinction.
PDF74/printed59 explicitly prints n./v.: sports versus exercise. The activity noun and exercise verb remain separate.
PDF77/printed62 explicitly prints n./v.: hobby versus be fond of. Possessed interest and liking action have different POS.
PDF77/printed62 explicitly prints v./n.: start versus beginning. The starting verb and initial-stage noun remain separate.
PDF80/printed65 explicitly prints prep./v.: than versus compare. Comparison marker and comparing action differ in POS and use.
PDF84/printed69 prints huā, v., spend; PDF128/printed113 prints huā, n., flower. Spending money/time is not the flower noun.
PDF100/printed85 prints bǐ, n., pen/pencil; PDF130/printed115 prints bǐ, m., stroke. Writing instrument and counted writing stroke are distinct.
PDF102/printed87 explicitly prints v./n.: take an examination versus examination. Taking the test and the test event have different POS.
PDF124/printed109 prints zhàn, n., stop/station; PDF137/printed122 prints zhàn, v., stand. Place and standing action differ.
PDF137/printed122 explicitly prints n./v./m.: bag, wrap, bundle. Preserve all three printed POS: container noun, wrapping verb, and package/bundle counter.
